remarks: Newly constructed in 2021, this 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment at Darien Place blends the charm of 1928 architecture with the convenience of modern life. Soaring ceilings, exposed brick, and oversized windows set a bold tone, while high-end finishes like Bosch appliances, custom privacy shades, and in-unit laundry, deliver everyday ease.  A custom built-in in the living room adds smart, stylish storage and functionality, enhancing the overall open-concept layout that's perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The bathroom features a sleek walk-in glass shower with a boutique hotel feel.  Apartment includes a reserved parking space in the parking lot, and a dedicated storage unit on the main level. Secure building with elevator and controlled access.  All of downtown Darien is just outside your door-restaurants, cafes, train, shops, and more. No smoking. Pet restrictions apply, please inquire.
